slides.title: IntegrationRescue
slides.message: The AI agent that fixes broken SaaS integrations and proves the business outcome.
bullets: Investigates · repairs in a sandbox · human-approved · independently verified
Create AI Agents Championship · Best Business AI Agent

bullets: Support → engineering → hours of manual tracing

slides.title: Who has the problem
slides.message: SaaS teams whose billing drives product access, especially small teams without a billing specialist.
bullets: Feels it: support, integration engineers, finance
Pays (hypothesis): head of engineering or support
slides.visual: Persona strip: support agent, platform engineer, finance lead

slides.title: Why today's tools stop short
slides.message: Monitoring trusts the 202; coding agents trust green tests; nobody checks the customer's outcome.
bullets: Coding agents: tests pass ≠ customer fixed
slides.visual: Three columns with where each tool stops, and a gap labelled 'business outcome'
slides.notes: Today's tools segment. No superiority claim: comparison not yet run.

slides.title: IntegrationRescue
slides.message: An AI agent that investigates like a careful engineer and only claims what an independent check proves.
bullets: Live Gemini agent decides what to investigate
slides.visual: Product screenshot: incident page with LIVE AI AGENT banner

slides.title: How the agent works
slides.message: The model decides; deterministic code enforces.
bullets: Investigate → Reproduce → Patch & test → Human approval → Promote → Verify
Says NO ACTION NEEDED or INDETERMINATE when true
slides.visual: Pipeline diagram with the approval gate and verifier highlighted
slides.notes: Why it is an agent, not an automation: decides what to check, whether to fix, when it cannot know.

slides.title: Live demo
slides.message: A real live Gemini run, end to end, in two minutes.
slides.notes: The demo plays here (0:00–2:00 of the pitch video).

slides.title: Architecture
slides.message: One container: agent, policy layer, simulated systems, verifier, dashboard.
bullets: Typed, phase-gated tools · patch policy · sandbox + replay
Read-only verifier derives truth from billing
slides.visual: Box diagram: Ticket → Agent (Gemini) ↔ Tools → Simulators; Policy; Sandbox; Approval; Verifier (read-only)
slides.notes: Backup slide for Q&A; not narrated in the 6-minute video.

slides.title: Reliability evidence
slides.message: Measured on live Gemini, including what does not work yet.
bullets: 16/17 correct outcomes after tool fix · 11/11 config & trust repairs verified
0 false success claims · 0 duplicate charges (72 runs)
slides.visual: Four big numbers; the code-repair number shown just as prominently
slides.notes: Evidence segment. Free-tier gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 2 seeds per variant: small samples.

slides.title: Safety and human oversight
slides.message: Safety lives in code, not in the prompt.
bullets: Only the independent verifier can say VERIFIED
Live test found the AI trusting an unverified key → now blocked in code
Model outage = MODEL UNAVAILABLE, never success

slides.title: Defensibility
slides.message: Verified outcomes, measured on a growing library of real incident patterns.
bullets: Incident library with hidden ground truth
slides.visual: Flywheel: incident → test case → better agent → more trust → more incidents
slides.notes: Defensibility segment. Honest: library is 5 families today.

slides.title: Business model
slides.message: Pay for proven fixes, not attempts (hypothesis).
bullets: Fee per VERIFIED resolution; nothing for a guess
Enterprise: VPC verifier, SSO, audit export
